page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highcpu-2 is an x86_64 architecture instance within the E2 server family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results place this instance in the lower performance tiers. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance is measured at 1105.98, while the multi-core score is 1452.89. Geekbench testing yields a single-core score of 906.0 and a multi-core score of 1073.0. Memory bandwidth is constrained, with read-only large block transfers reaching 13.03 GB/sec and write operations at 11.11 GB/sec. Static web serving throughput is recorded at 1.39 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the e2-highcpu-2 is its limited memory capacity of 2.0 GB alongside its 2 vCPUs, which restricts its suitability for memory-intensive applications. However, its hardware profile offers a cost-effective option for compute-focused workloads with minimal memory footprints. This instance is best suited for lightweight background utilities, basic web serving, small-scale software compilation, and simple text or image processing tasks.
